entry_state: Certain answers,conservation,events,conditional laws and solver scope now have distinct definitions and examples. Rounded principal amounts retain strict endpoint meaning. Section6.9 constructs a joint family from finite event templates and shared constraints; its completeness conditions continue91.
findings: 91: Joint event-template construction distinguishes a witness,complete scoped search and coverage of reality. Additive transition/reporting maps justify only declared aggregation; changed horizons or scenarios require revalidation. Finite probability updates enumerate disjoint hypotheses and preserve unresolved execution mass.

92–93: Real-domain interest has image[4.975,7.035); cent rounding yields206 displays4.98–7.03 while cent-grid inputs have maximum7.0343. Equal displays do not identify latent domains. Signed endpoints,ties,denominator status and operation order are explicit.

93: Equal terminal insurance cash88.3 does not preserve first-year equity or treaty order. A funded loan100 lacks the commitment baseline needed for allowance4. Conditional mass8/11 stays attached to unresolved execution; the complete supplied mean is77.

93–94: Positive payments and times give a strictly decreasing discounted-cash equation; only a certified sign-changing bracket establishes a unique root. Fees change the root,annual-effective fractional periods differ from prorating,and a half-cent-straddling enclosure cannot select a posting.

94–95: Bayes normalization requires positive evidence mass and semantic information identity. Exact equalities need an appropriate measure,not tiny-noise substitution. Completing the Gaussian square yields precision and information updates; the scalar example gives variance4/5,mean8/5 and cash mean116,variance80. A repeated datum is not independent evidence.
96: Observing X=1 fixes U=1 and Y=3; intervention replaces the X equation while retaining U,so meanY=2.5. Scheduler foresight is not manager information. Chapter6 closes with the distinctions intact.

Rendered91–96 read in order. Nineteen unchanged completed judgments reaffirmed. Correction to the previous segment narrative:85–90 recorded22 judgments,not the stated25; the saved mapping and tool count were correct. No manuscript defect confirmed.
